text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Claremore Avenue, between Park Street and McIntosh Street. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Claremore Avenue.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed humps on Claremore Avenue, between Park Street and McIntosh Street. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway for the installation of 11 speed humps on Claremore Avenue, between Park Street and McIntosh Street, generally, as shown on Attachment 2, Drawing TC-466, to the report (March 18, 2025) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services
